title: w16 full-TRAIN confirmation against Alpha3
research_question: Does the frozen 6×16 local-window candidate retain its Exp010 advantage when both it and active Alpha3 are trained on the full canonical ECG200 TRAIN split?
hypothesis: The 6×16 candidate will improve Q.ANT TEST accuracy over active Alpha3 while maintaining stable reference/Q.ANT behavior.

data_protocol.rule: Train both frozen candidates on all canonical TRAIN cases. No architecture or hyperparameter selection from TEST.

primary_metric: Aggregate integer correct Q.ANT TEST predictions across 1,000 predictions per model.
success_criteria: w16_candidate must produce at least 10 more correct Q.ANT TEST classifications than alpha3_w8 across 1,000 predictions, and its across-seed Q.ANT accuracy standard deviation must be no more than 0.01 absolute above Alpha3.
promotion_rule: If both criteria are met, promote the frozen 6×16 k=[1,2] candidate as PNN-v1 Alpha4. Otherwise retain Alpha3.
hardware_boundary: Software/simulation-backend experiment only; no real photonic hardware performance claim.
